summary: Build a foundation in ISO 21502 project management guidance and prepare for the PECB ISO 21502 Foundation exam.
audienceIntro: ISO 21502 Foundation suits people beginning or developing project management responsibilities who want an introduction to the standard’s guidance and practices.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO 21502 Foundation credential, the PECB course page lists completion of the training course, passing the exam, and signing the PECB Code of Ethics; it lists no professional, audit, or project experience requirements.
